evidence: Judged "If you want a licensed therapist" over "The best licensed, listed therapists you'll find that come close will be doing Internal Family Systems (IFS), or Schema Therapy...": the paragraph does tell a reader who wants licensure which therapies to look for (IFS, Schema) and where (Open Path Collective, the official site), and the heading adds no claim; it is the natural other half of the paragraph above, where reparenting therapists "often are not licensed". "Come close" has no antecedent right under the heading, but "my approach" in the paragraph's second sentence supplies it, so a reader who skips straight here is not left without a referent. The shared word "licensed" is the contrast with the paragraph above and the skimmer's handle, so I find T26 not happening; no other tell row is present, there are no linter findings, and the section's four headings (Inner Child Reparenting therapists / If you want a licensed therapist / Before choosing a therapist / AI therapy) read as a natural run of options for this guide, not a coverage taxonomy.
